title: Loos Center for the Arts

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Loos Center for the Arts has been renovated to offer the perfect gathering place for hosting everything from large-scale theater productions, galas and grand parties, to intimate gatherings and corporate meetings. ​From our 1,016-seat theater, where all touring and Academy productions take center stage - to the intimate 72-seat Lecture Hall, we have the perfect spaces for your events. The Atrium, Gallery, and outdoor patio can also be rented individually or combined for larger events such as fundraisers and corporate events. Let our expert staff help you create a memorable event! For more information on rental of the Loos Center for the Arts facilities, view our Tech Kit or email
